subject: a slim Englishwoman of the 1850s with dark brown hair parted in the middle and smoothed under a small white cap, a calm serious face, wearing a plain dark high-necked wool dress with a white collar

panels.01-calling: a sixteen-year-old English girl in a pale 1830s day dress standing alone in the garden of a large English country house at dawn, looking up at the sky through tall old trees, quiet and thoughtful, a sense of calling, England 1837
panels.02-kaiserswerth: {S} in a simple apron learning beside German deaconess nurses in plain dark dresses and white caps, in a clean whitewashed hospital ward with iron beds in 1851, an older deaconess showing her how to tend a patient, calm and orderly
panels.03-scutari: {S} arriving with a group of nurses in dark dresses and plain caps at the enormous stone barrack hospital at Scutari in November 1854, crowded long corridors with straw mattresses and sick soldiers in grey army blankets, the nurses carrying baskets of linen and supplies, determination, no blood
panels.04-lamp: {S} walking alone at night down a very long hospital corridor holding a small camp lamp, rows of sleeping soldiers on low cots on both sides, warm lamplight on her face, a soldier looking up gratefully, Scutari 1855, quiet compassion
panels.05-ledgers: {S} seated at a desk piled with ledgers and tables of numbers in a London study in 1857, working with a bearded Victorian statistician in a dark frock coat who points at a column of figures, oil lamp and quill pens, focused teamwork
panels.06-rose: {S} at a large table drawing a big circular wedge-shaped chart with ink and watercolour brushes, twelve petal-like wedges of different sizes radiating from the centre, sheets of figures and a ruler and compass beside her, London 1858, concentrated and determined, the chart without any writing
panels.07-school: {S} standing in a bright new hospital ward at St Thomas' Hospital in London in 1860, a row of young women probationer nurses in neat brown dresses and white caps and aprons listening to an older matron, iron beds with white linen, tall windows and sunlight, the beginning of nursing training
panels.08-letters: an elderly {S}, white-haired and wearing a white lace cap and a dark shawl, sitting up in bed in a quiet Victorian London bedroom in 1907, surrounded by stacks of letters, reports and books, a cat curled at the foot of the bed, soft window light, dignity and long service
